text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's time for the Hopeful Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But the audience only talks about two particular Umamusume who have continued to shine after their debut.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The buzz is all about Winning Ticket and Biwa Hayahide, and which of them will win the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Taishin steps up to the racecourse to show the world her true abilities and make her presence known.
